Method 1: 84 g of the compound of formula (II), 3.58 g of benzoyl peroxide and 500 mL of 1,2-dichloroethane were added to a four-necked round-bottom flask, the temperature was raised to 60 degrees C, and 52.8 g of bromine was added dropwise. The atmosphere was replaced with nitrogen 3 times, CO was introduced at 1-4 MPa, the temperature was raised, and the reaction was run at 85 degC for about 3 h.
